description: Kraken crypto exchange live ticker for a pair (e.g. "XBTUSD"). PREFER for 'current price of <coin>', 'bid and ask for <coin>', 'BTC spread'. Returns named bid, ask, spread, last_price, open_price, volume_24h and vwap_24h alongside Kraken's raw single-letter fields (a/b/c/v/p/o).
name: ticker
